name: Aihara Takuya
source:
Aihara Takuya is a normal, unimpressive guy. Most people don't notice him because he's short, weak, and sort of a nerd; his only extracurricular interest is the chemistry club. Accidents with chemicals have caused Takuya some unique and painful problems in the past, but his next one just may change his entire life! A seemingly innocuous spill has changed Takuya into a woman this time!

[Edited from [url=https://www.gamefaqs.com/pc/582010-x-change/faqs/22272]Ben Woodhouse's Walkthrough[/url]]
